title: Supreme Court Delivers Big Wins for Trump’s Immigration Agenda

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: In two polarized 6-3 decisions on Thursday, the Supreme Court delivered big wins for President Trump's immigration agenda, closing off yet another path
sentences.zh: 周四，最高法院以6比3的投票结果做出了两项两极分化的裁决，为特朗普总统的移民议程带来了重大胜利，堵死了又一条

sentences.en: to seek legal status in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国寻求合法身份的途径，

sentences.en: and potentially setting the stage for hundreds of thousands of people to be deported.
sentences.zh: 并可能为数十万人被驱逐出境铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Hamid Ali Aziz on how those rulings have given Trump new tools to reshape immigration in America.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事哈米德·阿里·阿齐兹将讲述这些裁决如何赋予了特朗普重塑美国移民政策的新工具。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hamid, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 哈米德，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about the specifics of these two new decisions from the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈最高法院这两项新裁决的具体细节。

sentences.en: One of them addresses temporary protected status,
sentences.zh: 其中一项涉及临时保护身份，

sentences.en: TPS for immigrants, and the other involves claims of asylum.
sentences.zh: 即针对移民的TPS，另一项则涉及庇护申请。

sentences.en: But before we do that, can you just start by putting these rulings into context for me?
sentences.zh: 但在我们开始之前，你能先为我梳理一下这些裁决的背景吗？

sentences.en: How important are they to the Trump administration's immigration agenda?
sentences.zh: 它们对特朗普政府的移民议程有多重要？

sentences.en: Yeah, they're very important.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们非常重要。

sentences.en: These are major victories for the Trump administration, in particular when it comes to this ruling on TPS.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普政府来说是重大的胜利，特别是在涉及TPS的这项裁决上。

sentences.en: I mean, this is something that has been a priority of the Trump administration, of Stephen Miller, to unwind these protections for nearly a decade now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，取消这些保护措施近十年来一直是特朗普政府和斯蒂芬·米勒的首要任务。

sentences.en: And every time they try to cut back these rulings affecting hundreds of thousands of people, they were stymied by the federal courts.
sentences.zh: 每当他们试图削减这些影响数十万人的裁决时，都会受到联邦法院的阻挠。

sentences.en: And so today really is a culmination of that effort in which the Supreme Court is essentially saying that this is the decision of the president
sentences.zh: 所以今天确实是这一努力的顶点，最高法院本质上是在说，这是总统

sentences.en: and the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 和国土安全部的决定。

sentences.en: Okay, so if we're going to look at these rulings one by one, it sounds like we should start with the TPS order.
sentences.zh: 好的，如果我们逐一审视这些裁决，听起来我们应该从TPS令开始。

sentences.en: So first, just remind us what TPS is, actually.
sentences.zh: 那么首先，请提醒我们TPS到底是什么。

sentences.en: What this case centers on.
sentences.zh: 这个案件的核心是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, temporary protected status really is as the phrase is defined.
sentences.zh: 是的，临时保护身份正如其字面定义那样。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a program that allows immigrants, regardless of their status, regardless of whether or not they have a deportation order,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个允许移民，无论其身份如何，无论他们是否收到了驱逐令，

sentences.en: the ability to be protected from deportation and have work authorization because their home country is too dangerous to deport them to.
sentences.zh: 都能获得免于驱逐的保护并拥有工作许可的项目，因为他们的祖国太危险，无法将他们遣返回去。

sentences.en: And historically, that's because of conflict, wars, or natural disasters.
sentences.zh: 历史上，这是由于冲突、战争或自然灾害造成的。

sentences.en: In those instances, the DHS secretary has just decided that this group of people will be protected from deportation.
sentences.zh: 在这些情况下，国土安全部部长决定保护这群人免于被驱逐。

sentences.en: Okay, and what was the challenge that the court was considering here?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么法院在这里审理的挑战是什么？

sentences.en: So what happened here was, really, when you look back to the first Trump administration, there's been a focus amongst Trump officials to go after this program.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的事情是，当你回顾第一届特朗普政府时，特朗普的官员们一直专注于针对这个项目。

sentences.en: Specifically, the concern has been that this temporary protected status program is no longer temporary.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他们担心的是这个临时保护身份项目不再是“临时”的了。

sentences.en: That people are on TPS for years, for decades, and it's essentially turning into, in their words, an amnesty.
sentences.zh: 人们持有TPS已经几年甚至几十年了，用他们的话说，这本质上变成了一种大赦。

sentences.en: So you saw the first Trump administration attempt to unwind TPS for groups, including Haitians, and they were stymied by court challenges.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到第一届特朗普政府试图取消包括海地人在内的群体的TPS，但遭到了法院挑战的阻挠。

sentences.en: Biden comes in,
sentences.zh: 拜登上台后，

sentences.en: Biden totally explodes the TPS program, really expands the pools of population who could get TPS.
sentences.zh: 彻底引爆了TPS项目，真正扩大了可以获得TPS的人群范围。

sentences.en: It's really an unprecedented level of people.
sentences.zh: 这确实是前所未有的规模。

sentences.en: And so this administration, the Trump administration part two, comes in really with a focus on TPS, including it's in some of the first-day executive orders.
sentences.zh: 所以这届政府，即特朗普政府的第二阶段，上台后确实把重点放在了TPS上，甚至将其列入了首日的行政命令中。

sentences.en: And so DHS secretary at the time, former DHS secretary Noem, unwinds TPS protections for Venezuelans, for Haitians, for most of the populations that have TPS.
sentences.zh: 当时的国土安全部部长，前部长诺姆，取消了委内瑞拉人、海地人以及大多数持有TPS群体的保护措施。

sentences.en: And so in this case, you have Haitians and Syrians who she unwinded the protections for last year.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，你看到的是她去年取消了保护措施的海地人和叙利亚人。

sentences.en: And the advocates representing these populations essentially are saying she didn't follow the right process and are pointing out all these deficiencies with the process
sentences.zh: 代表这些群体的倡导者本质上是在说，她没有遵循正确的程序，并指出了她在撤销保护措施时

sentences.en: with which she undid the protections.
sentences.zh: 程序上的所有缺陷。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So advocates representing those groups of migrants sue the administration saying they didn't go about the unwinding correctly.
sentences.zh: 所以代表这些移民群体的倡导者起诉了政府，称他们取消保护措施的方式不正确。

sentences.en: And that case ultimately makes it to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 而那个案件最终闹到了最高法院。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court in its ruling said that the decision to unwind TPS is not reviewable by the judicial branch.
sentences.zh: 最高法院在裁决中表示，取消TPS的决定不受司法部门的审查。

sentences.en: That judges do not have the ability to come in and stop a DHS decision unwinding TPS.
sentences.zh: 法官没有能力介入并阻止国土安全部取消TPS的决定。

sentences.en: In fact, this is in the power of the DHS secretary.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是国土安全部部长的权力。

sentences.en: It's in the statute.
sentences.zh: 法律条文中就是这么写的。

sentences.en: It is not reviewable by the courts.
sentences.zh: 法院对此不予审查。

sentences.en: Meaning, essentially the court is saying there is no role for us here in stopping the executive branch from winding this program down.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，本质上法院是在说，我们在这里没有角色去阻止行政部门逐步取消这个项目。

sentences.en: That's just not our job.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们的工作。

sentences.en: It's not in the law.
sentences.zh: 法律里没有这一条。

sentences.en: We can't do that.
sentences.zh: 我们做不到。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So, you called this a pretty big win for the administration.
sentences.zh: 所以，你称这对政府来说是一个相当大的胜利。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Like, what does this mean for them on a practical level?
sentences.zh: 这在实际层面上对他们意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, so this decision specifically affects
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这个决定具体影响了

sentences.en: Haitians and Syrians.
sentences.zh: 海地人和叙利亚人。

sentences.en: And when it comes to Haitians, there's more than
sentences.zh: 就海地人而言，有超过

sentences.en: 300,000 Haitians who have TPS.
sentences.zh: 30万海地人持有TPS。

sentences.en: Syrians, it's around
sentences.zh: 叙利亚人大约有

sentences.en: But, really, what this decision does is it opens the ability for the administration to unwind TPS whole scale.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这个决定所做的是为政府全面取消TPS打开了大门。

sentences.en: And we have multiple decisions coming down the road.
sentences.zh: 未来我们还会看到更多的裁决。

sentences.en: we have decision that the DHS secretary will have to make on TPS for Salvadorans, for Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部部长将不得不对萨尔瓦多人和乌克兰人的TPS做出决定。

sentences.en: For Salvadorans, that's more than
sentences.zh: 对于萨尔瓦多人来说，人数超过

sentences.en: 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 10万人。

sentences.en: For Ukrainians, that's more than
sentences.zh: 对于乌克兰人来说，人数超过

sentences.en: 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 10万人。

sentences.en: There are other court cases right now involving TPS in the lower courts, thousands of those people.
sentences.zh: 目前下级法院还有其他涉及TPS的案件，涉及数千人。

sentences.en: So, really, you're starting to think about a pretty broad group of people who could suddenly lose status and who could potentially become targets for ICE.
sentences.zh: 所以，你实际上是在考虑一个相当广泛的群体，他们可能会突然失去身份，并可能成为移民及海关执法局（ICE）的目标。

sentences.en: Essentially, you have the situation in which the Trump administration may now be able to go one by one through these populations and remove protections for them.
sentences.zh: 本质上，你现在面临的情况是，特朗普政府可能能够逐一审查这些群体，并取消对他们的保护。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it could also really allow the administration to boost their deportation numbers because it opens up these individuals for potential removal from the United States.
sentences.zh: 是的，这也确实能让政府提高他们的驱逐数量，因为它让这些人面临被从美国驱逐的可能。

sentences.en: But it also has some downstream effects as well.
sentences.zh: 但它也有一些后续影响。

sentences.en: There is a belief that TPS and these types of programs incentivize people to cross into the country illegally, and one of the administration's goals has been to show this picture
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，TPS和这类项目激励了人们非法越境，而政府的目标之一就是展示这样一幅图景：

sentences.en: of the United States as not a place where people who are in the country illegally can comfortably live.
sentences.zh: 美国不是非法居留者可以舒适生活的地方。

sentences.en: And so this is just another facet of that approach, which is you are not going to have the ability to be protected from deportation, to work legally, and to be safe from
sentences.zh: 所以这只是该方针的另一个侧面，即你将无法再获得免于驱逐的保护，无法合法工作，也无法免受

sentences.en: an ICE officer coming to your door arresting you and placing you in a detention cell.
sentences.zh: ICE官员上门逮捕并将你关进拘留室的威胁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember one of the big criticisms of the Biden administration when it expanded TPS was that this was creating an incentive for people to come.
sentences.zh: 我记得拜登政府扩大TPS时，最大的批评之一就是这在激励人们前来。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the Biden administration would dispute that, but incentives and what causes people to cross the border is something that DHS has long studied, because they
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，拜登政府会反驳这一点，但激励措施以及是什么导致人们越境是国土安全部长期研究的课题，因为无论哪届政府，他们

sentences.en: are constantly, regardless of administration, really worried about spikes at the southern border.
sentences.zh: 都一直非常担心南部边境的激增。

sentences.en: That really hasn't been an issue for this administration, because they have sent this, again, they've sent the picture that if you cross into the country illegally, not only will
sentences.zh: 这对本届政府来说确实不是问题，因为他们再次传达了这样一个信息：如果你非法越境，不仅

sentences.en: you likely be turned back, but even if you are able to make it into the United
sentences.zh: 你很可能会被遣返，即使你能成功进入美国，

sentences.en: States, your life is going to be very uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 你的生活也会非常不舒服。

sentences.en: You're not going to have the same type of ability to stay in the country indefinitely and make a life for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你将无法再像以前那样无限期地留在国内并为自己创造生活。

sentences.en: Christian advocates who challenged the administration on their efforts to unwind these programs, their contention right is that these programs are worth keeping because they are
sentences.zh: 挑战政府取消这些项目努力的基督教倡导者，他们的主张是这些项目值得保留，因为它们是

sentences.en: humanitarian efforts.
sentences.zh: 人道主义努力。

sentences.en: They protect people who otherwise would be living in really dangerous countries, and keeping them around is part of what makes
sentences.zh: 它们保护了那些本会生活在非常危险国家的人，保留它们是塑造

sentences.en: America what it is.
sentences.zh: 美国特质的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, the whole idea here, ultimately, when it comes to TPS, is that we can't deport these people to their home country because their home country is in some state of crisis.
sentences.zh: 是的，归根结底，关于TPS的整个理念是，我们不能把这些人遣返回他们的祖国，因为他们的祖国处于某种危机状态。

sentences.en: Either there was an earthquake or some intense natural disaster or there's war and conflict.
sentences.zh: 要么是发生了地震或其他严重的自然灾害，要么是战争和冲突。

sentences.en: I mean, you look at
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看

sentences.en: Haiti, which has been in turmoil for years now with issues with government, with protection of people, of policing, of all kinds of intense conflict, as our colleagues here
sentences.zh: 海地，多年来一直处于动荡之中，政府、人民保护、治安以及各种激烈的冲突都存在问题，正如我们的同事在这里

sentences.en: have covered really extensively.
sentences.zh: 所广泛报道的那样。

sentences.en: And so the idea of deporting
sentences.zh: 所以，对于这些倡导者来说，遣返

sentences.en: Haitians there and protecting them from that deportation, for these advocates, they felt like it was incredibly important because you'd be sending people to definite danger.
sentences.zh: 海地人并保护他们免受遣返的想法，他们觉得极其重要，因为你是在把人送往确定的危险之中。

sentences.en: And so that's the whole idea behind the program, is to protect people from that.
sentences.zh: 这就是该项目背后的全部理念，即保护人们免受那种危险。

sentences.en: And these conversations were had during the
sentences.zh: 这些对话在

sentences.en: Biden administration, and the whole idea when TPS exploded was there were a lot of advocates who were pushing the administration to expand the population of TPS, to protect
sentences.zh: 拜登政府期间进行过，当TPS项目爆发式增长时，整个想法是，许多倡导者在推动政府扩大TPS人群，以保护

sentences.en: people from
sentences.zh: 人们免受

sentences.en: deportation because of the various conflicts across the globe.
sentences.zh: 因全球各地各种冲突而导致的驱逐。

sentences.en: But those types of arguments really fall on deaf ears with this administration.
sentences.zh: 但这些论点在这一届政府面前真的如同对牛弹琴。

sentences.en: I believe at one point Stephen
sentences.zh: 我相信有一次斯蒂芬·

sentences.en: Miller, when somebody brought up the idea that in one of these cases this was saving people from being sent to a conflict zone, he said that that was a large part of the globe.
sentences.zh: 米勒在有人提出其中一个案例是在拯救人们免于被送往冲突地区时，他说那可是全球很大一部分地区。

sentences.en: So should we bring in everybody from across the globe?
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该把全球各地的人都接过来吗？

sentences.en: Is that what we should be doing?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们应该做的吗？

sentences.en: So that's their perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他们的观点。

sentences.en: It doesn't really move them, this idea that there's conflict or natural disasters and we can't deport people to those countries.
sentences.zh: 这种认为存在冲突或自然灾害、我们不能将人们遣返回这些国家的想法，并不能真正打动他们。

sentences.en: You started to explore this,
sentences.zh: 你开始探讨这个问题了，

sentences.en: Hamid, but beyond just how hard it is potentially going to be for people to go back to their home countries in some cases,
sentences.zh: 哈米德，但除了人们在某些情况下回到祖国可能有多困难之外，

sentences.en: of this size.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这种规模，

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the whole idea of these historic mass deportations unlike America had ever seen before in the run-up to this administration, we haven't seen that thus far.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，在这一届政府上台前，那种美国从未见过的大规模驱逐的整个想法，我们目前还没有看到。

sentences.en: They have certainly really ramped up efforts inside the country and deporting people from inside the country, but they are not at a point where they could look at a population
sentences.zh: 他们当然确实加强了国内的执法力度，并从国内驱逐人员，但他们还没有达到那种程度，比如在一个月内看到50万人失去身份，

sentences.en: of 500,000 people who lose status, for example, in a given month and be able to target those people and deport them quickly.
sentences.zh: 并能迅速锁定这些人并将他们驱逐出境。

sentences.en: There's a lot of bureaucracy that's involved.
sentences.zh: 这涉及大量的官僚程序。

sentences.en: This population, this group of people who got
sentences.zh: 这群人，这群获得

sentences.en: TPS, they have been in constant contact with the federal government sharing their information on where they live, they have that information,
sentences.zh: TPS的人，他们一直与联邦政府保持联系，分享他们居住地的信息，政府掌握这些信息，

sentences.en: but the ability to arrest people is just one level to it.
sentences.zh: 但逮捕人的能力只是其中一个层面。

sentences.en: They have to have space to detain these people, they have to have planes to put these people on, and perhaps most importantly, they have to get the countries to agree to take them.
sentences.zh: 他们必须有空间拘留这些人，必须有飞机把这些人送走，最重要的是，他们必须让这些国家同意接收他们。
